title: Show blog metadata and reading time
description: As a logged-in blogger, I want each post in my list to show its metadata, so that I can see at a glance who wrote it, when, and how long it takes to read.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each post on 'My Blogs' shows Title, Author, Date, Words and Reading time.
Words equals the number of whitespace-separated words in the post content (see BR-META-01).
Reading time equals ceil(Words / 200) minutes with a minimum of 1 minute (see BR-META-02).
